What We Do

Molding
Capabilities

Advanced molding technologies paired with engineering support — enabling smooth design-to-production transitions for complex, multi-material components.

01
Thermoplastic Injection Molding
High-volume production of thermoplastic parts with excellent dimensional stability and surface quality. Suitable for connectors, housings, and structural components requiring consistent repeatability across thousands of cycles.
ABSPCNylonPEEKPP
02
Overmolding & Insert Molding
Combine multiple materials or encapsulate metal inserts in a single molding cycle. Ideal for ergonomic grips, sealed electrical components, and parts requiring both rigidity and flexibility in one assembly.
2-ShotCo-MoldingMetal InsertBrass / Stainless
03
Thermoset & High-Performance Molding
Precision molding of epoxy, phenolic, and other thermoset materials for demanding electrical and thermal applications. Supports micro molding for miniaturized components with sub-millimeter features.
EpoxyPhenolicMicro MoldingHigh-Temp
04
Multi-Cavity & High-Volume Production
Fully automated multi-cavity tooling for large-scale production runs. Integrated quality inspection, automated part removal, and optimized cycle times drive down unit cost while maintaining SPI A1 surface standards.

How It Works

Our Process

A structured, engineering-led workflow from your first drawing to final mass production delivery.

1
DFM Review
Upload your drawing. Our engineers assess wall thickness, draft angles, gate location, and parting line within 24 hours.
2
Material Selection
We recommend the optimal resin based on mechanical, thermal, electrical, and regulatory requirements for your application.
3
Tooling & Mold Build
In-house mold design and fabrication. Single-cavity prototype tools or hardened multi-cavity production tools built to spec.
4
T1 Sample & Validation
First article samples produced for dimensional inspection, functional testing, and customer approval before production release.
5
Mass Production
Automated multi-cavity production with inline inspection, SPC monitoring, and consistent cycle time control at scale.
6
Delivery & Support
Packed to spec, inspection reports included. Ongoing engineering support for design revisions and production scaling.

Medical Devices

Why KongDe

Our Advantages

In-House Tooling
Mold design, build, and maintenance entirely in-house. Faster iterations, direct cost control, and no dependency on third-party toolmakers for schedule-critical projects.
SPI A1 Surface Quality
Mirror-polished mold cavities and controlled process parameters achieve up to SPI A1 surface grade — suitable for optical components, consumer goods, and high-aesthetic applications.
Scalable from Day One
Prototype-grade single-cavity tooling for early validation, then seamless transition to high-cavitation production molds — same engineering team, same quality standards throughout.
Full Engineering Support
DFM review, material selection, and mold flow analysis before any steel is cut. Our engineering team catches design issues early — saving cost, time, and mold rework.
